summary: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories filed a Form 6-K on July 23, 2026, providing a link to audio recordings of its earnings call for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, held on July 22, 2026. The filing is a routine communication to exchanges, with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change. No deal terms or structural mechanics are disclosed.
